mapper.sql: SELECT pm.id as managementId, pm.process_instance_id, pm.process_definition_id, pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key, pm.process_status, pm.start_time, pm.end_time, pm.business_name, pm.approve_status, pm.act_process_definition_id, pm.create_user_id as managementCreateUserId, ptm.id AS taskManagementId, ptm.cur_activity_id, ptm.task_id, ptm.cur_approve_id, ptm.cur_approve_name, ptm.task_status, ptm.timeout_status, ptm.timeout_warn_time, ptm.timeout_handle_type, ptm.timeout_handle_time, ptm.start_time AS taskStartTime, ptm.approve_time, ptm.approve_id, ptm.approve_name, ptm.remark, ptm.pre_activity_id, ptm.execution_id, ptm.cur_activity_name FROM process_management pm , process_task_management ptm where pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id and pm.is_deleted = false and ptm.is_deleted = false
mapper.select: AND approve_status = 'approveIng' AND pm.business_id = #{businessId} AND pm.business_key = #{businessKey} AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' ORDER BY ptm.create_time ASC

AND ptm.timeout_warn_time <= now()
AND ptm.timeout_handle_time <= now()
AND ptm.task_id = #{taskId}
AND ptm.timeout_status = #{timeoutStatus} AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' ORDER BY ptm.create_time ASC LIMIT 200

AND approve_status = 'approveIng'AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng'
and ptm.id in
#{id}
ORDER BY ptm.create_time ASC

SELECT pm.process_instance_id, pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key, pm.business_name, string_agg(ptm.cur_activity_id,',') AS activityId, string_agg(ptm.cur_activity_name,',') AS activityName, string_agg(ptm.cur_approve_id,',') AS curApproveId, string_agg(ptm.cur_approve_name,',') AS curApproveName FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = false AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' WHERE pm.is_deleted = false and pm.process_status = 'running' and (pm.business_id, pm.business_key) in
(#{item.businessId}, #{item.businessKey})
GROUP BY pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key,pm.process_instance_id, pm.business_name

SELECT pm.process_instance_id, pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_key, pm.business_name, ptm.cur_activity_id AS activityId, ptm.cur_activity_name AS activityName, ptm.cur_approve_id AS curApproveId, ptm.cur_approve_name AS curApproveName FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = false AND ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' WHERE pm.is_deleted = false AND (ptm.cur_approve_id, pm.business_key) in
(#{item.curApproveId}, #{item.businessKey})

select ptm.id, pm.process_name, ptm.cur_activity_id, ptm.cur_activity_name, ptm.cur_approve_id, ptm.cur_approve_name, ptm.task_status, ptm.approve_time, ptm.label_json from process_task_management ptm inner join process_management pm on pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id and pm.is_deleted = false
ptm.is_deleted = false and pm.id = #{params.id}

select tptm.id, tpm.process_instance_name as process_name , tptm.sys_user_id as cur_approve_id , tptm.node_id as cur_activity_id, tptm.node_name as cur_activity_name, '' AS cur_approve_name, tptm.task_status, null as label_json, tpm.end_time as approveTime from third_process_task_management tptm inner join third_process_management tpm on tptm.main_id = tpm.id and tpm.is_deleted = false where tptm.is_deleted = false and tpm.id = #{params.id}

SELECT * FROM ( -- 第一部分：内部流程数据 SELECT pm.id, pm.process_instance_id, pm.process_definition_id, pm.process_version, pm.process_status, pm.process_name, pm.business_id, pm.business_code, pm.business_name, pm.business_key, pm.act_process_definition_id, CONCAT(wm.detail_url, pm.business_id) AS detail_url, pm.create_time AS createTime, pm.update_time AS updateTime, pm.create_user_id AS createUserId, pm.end_time, 'erp' AS sourcePlatform, case when pm.process_status = 'running' then latest_task.cur_activity_id else '' end as cur_activity_id, case when pm.process_status = 'running' then latest_task.cur_activity_name else '' end as cur_activity_name FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (process_instance_id) process_instance_id, cur_activity_id, cur_activity_name FROM process_task_management WHERE is_deleted = false ORDER BY process_instance_id, id DESC ) latest_task ON pm.process_instance_id = latest_task.process_instance_id LEFT JOIN work_menu wm ON pm.business_key = wm.module_code AND wm.is_deleted = false WHERE pm.is_deleted = false
UNION ALL
-- 第二部分：第三方流程数据 SELECT tpm.id, tpm.process_instance_id, tpm.process_definition_id, NULL AS process_version, tpm.status AS process_status, tpm.process_instance_name AS process_name, tpm.business_id, tpm.business_code, '' AS business_name, tpm.business_key, '' AS act_process_definition_id, '' AS detail_url, tpm.create_time AS createTime, tpm.update_time AS updateTime, tpm.create_user_id AS createUserId, tpm.end_time, 'fs' AS sourcePlatform, case when tpm.status = 'running' then latest_third_task.cur_activity_id else '' end as cur_activity_id, case when tpm.status = 'running' then latest_third_task.cur_activity_name else '' end as cur_activity_name FROM third_process_management tpm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (main_id) main_id, node_id AS cur_activity_id, node_name AS cur_activity_name FROM third_process_task_management WHERE is_deleted = false ORDER BY main_id, id DESC ) latest_third_task ON tpm.id = latest_third_task.main_id WHERE tpm.is_deleted = false ) pp WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default}
and (pp.label_json ->> 'isDelegate')::boolean is true
ORDER BY pp.createTime DESC
select id from process_management where business_key = #{businessType} and create_time between '2025-05-12' and '2025-06-06'
